title: Job hunting just got easier with this $30 AI-powered helper
excerpt: This AI-powered job tool helps you stand out from the crowd.
content_html:
TL;DR: Make job hunting easier forever with this lifetime subscription to FirstResume AI Job Hunting Automator, now only $29.99 (reg. $899) with code Aug25 through Aug. 9.

Credit: FirstResume

$29.99
$899 Save $869.01

Job hunting is stressful enough — don’t make creating your resume a headache, too. With FirstResume AI Job Hunting Automator, applying to positions can be painless. This AI-powered tool helps you tailor resumes, whip out cover letters, and even send outreach emails.

Right now, you can lock in a lifetime subscription to FirstResume AI Job Hunting Automator for just $29.99 with code Aug25 through Aug. 9.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

Gone are the days of spending hours tailoring your resume to each individual job you apply for — only to never hear anything back? FirstResume AI Job Hunting Automator makes the process a whole lot easier with job-hunting tools designed for Gen Z that can help everyone.

FirstResume can create tailored ATS-friendly resumes and cover letters that can help you stand out, while also penning outreach emails to help get you noticed once your application is submitted.

Curious how it works? Give FirstResume your resume and let the advanced AI deliver a human-level analysis and helpful feedback, serving as your very own career coach that can spot gaps and tell a strong story.

From there, once you find jobs you want to apply for, you can paste them into FirstResume. This tool will create an ATS-optimized resume for that position with just a click, ensuring your most relevant experience comes first.

Your lifetime subscription gives you 5,000 credits per month, unlimited job tracking, unlimited resume storage, early access to new features, and priority customer support if needed.

找工作的压力已经够大了——别让写简历也成为一件令人头疼的事情。 借助 FirstResume AI 求职自动化器，申请职位可以轻松无忧。 这个人工智能驱动的工具可以帮助您定制简历、制作求职信，甚至发送外展电子邮件。

现在，您只需 29.99 美元即可使用优惠码 8 月 25 日至 8 月 9 日锁定 FirstResume AI Job Hunting Automator 的终身订阅。

混搭优惠

花费数小时根据申请的每份工作定制简历却收不到任何回复的日子已经一去不复返了吗？ FirstResume AI 求职自动化器通过专为 Z 世代设计的求职工具使整个过程变得更加容易，可以帮助每个人。

FirstResume 可以创建适合 ATS 的定制简历和求职信，帮助您脱颖而出，同时还可以撰写外展电子邮件，帮助您在提交申请后引起注意。

好奇它是如何工作的？ 向 FirstResume 提供您的简历，让先进的人工智能提供人类水平的分析和有用的反馈，充当您自己的职业教练，可以发现差距并讲述一个强有力的故事。

从那里，一旦您找到想要申请的工作，您就可以将它们粘贴到 FirstResume 中。 只需点击一下该工具即可为该职位创建一份经过 ATS 优化的简历，确保您最相关的经验优先。

您的终身订阅为您提供每月 5,000 个积分、无限制的作业跟踪、无限制的简历存储、提前访问新功能以及优先客户支持（如果需要）。
